segments.name: Vision-Based Platform Solutions
segments.description: Visual monitoring AI solutions with small sensors deployed to monitor critical safety components in hard-to-reach harsh environments for multiple industries.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment specializing in vision-based platform solutions as described in Note 1.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for initial kit sales including vision-based sensors and processing unit, with future recurring revenue from multi-year software subscriptions.
revenueModel.evidence: This strategy allows for immediate revenue generation from system sales, while also setting a base that we believe will allow us in the future to create a steady stream of recurring revenue from multi-year software subscriptions services when the warranty expires.
